result:
Phase 3 (UI) complete. Summary of what landed:

**Files written (all under `src/components/nocturne/` + `src/app/nocturne/`):**

Client store:
- `nocturne-provider.tsx` — the aria-pattern client store: session bootstrap (probe + embed auto-login), per-page data loading (role-gated audit lane), the `nocturne-reset` embed-reset message listener (origin-check + shape-check, mount only when `embed === true`), the provider-owned clock tick (`nowIso` + `fmt.countdown/duration` — the render path never touches `Date.now()`), and 401 → login-gate handling in `fetchJson`. Exposes `userName`/`fmtTimestamp` helpers (lib format helpers, no Date.now).

App shell (`src/app/nocturne/`):
- `page.tsx` — Suspense/async-inner F3 pin: reads `?embed=1` + the `nocturne_ses` cookie server-side, passes `embed`/`hasSession` as props.
- `layout.tsx` + `globals.css` — scoped stylesheet (parley pattern, `@source` scoped to nocturne trees only) + the `.nocturne-scope` wrapper.
- `status/[slug]/page.tsx` — the public status route's client body (no auth, its own provider).

Screens (`src/components/nocturne/`):
- `shell.tsx`, `login.tsx`, `primitives.tsx` (chips, Kpi, ReasonGate, SparkBar — cadence accessible-SVG conventions), `dashboard.tsx` (5 KPIs + active incidents with live SLA countdowns), `incidents.tsx` (list + detail: timeline in at-then-id order, notes composer, runbook checklists, postmortem panel, ack/resolve/snooze/escalate as RBAC-disabled-with-reason surfaces + the ack-before-resolve + terminals-are-final invariants as disabled states), `services.tsx` (on-call window + escalation tiers + component-status override), `rotations.tsx` (weekly schedule + seat tiling + overrides), `runbooks.tsx`, `postmortems.tsx`, `analytics.tsx` (MTTA/MTTR KPIs + severity/service bars + on-call load, accessible SVG), `members.tsx` (members + invites + RBAC matrix + audit feed), `public-status.tsx`.

Tests (`src/components/nocturne/__tests__/`):
- `nocturne-components.test.tsx` — 20 tests (bootstrap, login, shell nav by role, all views, the embed-reset handshake ×3, RBAC-disabled-with-reason ×2)
- `nocturne-invariant.test.tsx` — 8 tests (ack-before-resolve, terminals-are-final, timeline at-then-id order, the disabled-state surfaces)

**Verification:**
- `bun test src/components/nocturne` → **28/28 pass, 0 fail**
- `bun test src` → **1909/1909 pass, 0 fail** (1881 prior + 28 new)
- `bun run typecheck` → clean
